items.title: Robinhood faces shareholder challenge as SEC loosens proxy oversight
items.summary: Nov 20 (Reuters) - A shareholder activist group called for online brokerage Robinhood to review its proxy-voting platform, concerned that retail investors ‌aren't getting fair choices as financial regulators weaken balloting rules for corporate ‌annual meetings. Robinhood and its Say investor-communications arm are at the center of changes coming to contests like ​director elections or CEO pay approvals.

items.title: ExxonMobil Sinks 11% in a Month as Oil Slides. Darren Woods Says Its Earnings Power Comes From “Lasting Improvements”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysExxonMobil shares are down 11% in the past month as oil prices fell on hopes for an end to the Iran war, alongside a broad market selloff. Refining earned more than half of Exxon’s third-quarter adjusted profit, and the market treats that kind of windfall as temporary.
